answer: Randomized cohort isolation is one concrete defense. Every epoch the protocol hashes the public beacon and assigns each identity to exactly one shard, so a farm cannot cluster its puppets where they can vouch for one another. To earn, an identity must wander across shards in later epochs and gather attestations from peers it never co-resided with, building a continuous ledge of escrowed stake that unlocks only after several disjoint-shard cycles. Forging that record costs an entire island of separate identities plus a distinct stake per shard, because one key cannot serve two cohorts at once.
